content.json:
ICO Security Operations Command Center  build 3.5
Every panel is one of six patterns. See docs/D2-recipes.md to add or change one.

parameters.name: Analyst
parameters.label: Assigned analyst
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend A = iff(isempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)), "Unassigned", tostring(Owner.assignedTo))
| distinct A
| order by A asc
   | project Value = tostring(A))
| project Value

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.label: Analytic rule
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| distinct Title
| order by Title asc
   | project Value = tostring(Title))
| project Value

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.label: Incident provider
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| mv-expand P = AdditionalData.alertProductNames to typeof(string)
| distinct P
| where isnotempty(P)
| order by P asc
   | project Value = tostring(P))
| project Value

parameters.name: User
parameters.label: User
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(CompromisedEntity)
| distinct CompromisedEntity
| order by CompromisedEntity asc
| take 500
   | project Value = tostring(CompromisedEntity))
| project Value

content.query:

| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where "{IncidentStatus}" == "All" or Status == "{IncidentStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend AnalystName = iff(isempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)), "Unassigned", tostring(Owner.assignedTo))
| where "{Analyst}" == "All" or AnalystName == "{Analyst}"
| where "{Rule}" == "All" or Title == "{Rule}"
| extend ProviderName = tostring(AdditionalData.alertProductNames)
| where "{Provider}" == "All" or ProviderName has "{Provider}"

| extend Metric = "Total"
| extend Context = "all statuses"

content.json: SLA breach tracking —
Time to first touch against the per-severity targets set above, for incidents created in range. Adjust the targets to match your policy.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where "{IncidentStatus}" == "All" or Status == "{IncidentStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend AnalystName = iff(isempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)), "Unassigned", tostring(Owner.assignedTo))
| where "{Analyst}" == "All" or AnalystName == "{Analyst}"
| where "{Rule}" == "All" or Title == "{Rule}"
| extend Provider = tostring(AdditionalData.alertProductNames)
| where "{Provider}" == "All" or Provider has "{Provider}"
// Scope to incidents CREATED in the selected window.
// The filter above selects on TimeGenerated, which is when the row was
// WRITTEN -- i.e. when the incident was last updated. Without this an
// incident opened six months ago but touched yesterday still appears.
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| extend AgeHours = (now() - CreatedTime) / 1h
| extend TargetHours = case(Severity == "High", {SlaHigh},
                            Severity == "Medium", {SlaMedium},
                            {SlaLow})
| extend ElapsedHours = iff(isnotempty(FirstModifiedTime),
    (FirstModifiedTime - CreatedTime) / 1h, AgeHours)
| extend SLA = iff(ElapsedHours > TargetHours, "BREACHED", "Within SLA")
| where SLA == "BREACHED"
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Analyst = AnalystName,
          TargetHours, ElapsedHours = round(ElapsedHours, 1), SLA, CreatedTime
| order by ElapsedHours desc
| take 100
content.noDataMessage: No SLA breaches. Everything is within target.
content.title: SLA breaches

content.query:
// Department and job title come from Entra ID user attributes.
// If coverage is low, every division breakdown reads 'Unmapped'.
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Rows = count(),
            WithDepartment = countif(isnotempty(tostring(UsersInsights.Department))),
            WithJobTitle = countif(isnotempty(tostring(UsersInsights.JobTitle)))
| extend DepartmentCoverage = strcat(tostring(iff(Rows > 0,
    round(100.0 * WithDepartment / Rows, 0), 0.0)), "%")
| extend JobTitleCoverage = strcat(tostring(iff(Rows > 0,
    round(100.0 * WithJobTitle / Rows, 0), 0.0)), "%")
| project Rows, DepartmentCoverage, JobTitleCoverage

content.query:
// Geographic anomaly: one identity acting from several locations.
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(SourceIPLocation) and isnotempty(UserPrincipalName)
| where "{User}" == "All" or UserPrincipalName has "{User}"
| extend Subject = iff("{IdentityDisplay}" == "Actual", UserPrincipalName, strcat("user-", substring(hash_sha256(UserPrincipalName), 0, 8)))
| summarize Locations = dcount(SourceIPLocation),
            SeenFrom = make_set(SourceIPLocation, 8),
            Priority = sum(InvestigationPriority) by Subject
| where Locations > 1
| order by Locations desc, Priority desc
| take 25
